entries.title: Merge cards compare before and after in a table
entries.body: On a merge card for a GitHub or GitLab pull request, each view's pictures now sit in a table with Before and After at the top of their columns, so each label clearly belongs to the pictures under it. Matching pictures share a row, and a new view gets its own table headed New.

picture.alt: A merge card view in a boxed table headed Before and After, with the dark and light pictures of each state paired row by row
